newsitem.title: USA: Spacehab to post Q1 extraordinary gain.
newsitem.headline: Spacehab to post Q1 extraordinary gain.

text.p: Spacehab Inc said Wednesday it has signed an amended and restated credit agreement with its two senior lenders that will lead the company to recognize an extraordinary, pre-tax gain of about $4.2 million in the first quarter of 1997.
Under the terms of the agreement, all security interests of both lenders in Spacehab's assets and all restrictive covenants existing under the prior credit agreement have been released.

Before the August 20 amendment, Spacehab had outstanding debt under the credit agreement of $8.7 million to one of the senior lenders. About $3.2 million of that was bearing interest at a rate of one percent per month, and about $5.5 million was non-interest bearing.

A payment of $2.5 million was made on August 20 and an unsecured note in the amount of $2 million was given by Spacehab to that senior lender. The $2 million note is non-interest bearing and will be repaid over five years, beginning August 1997.
All other remaining debts to that senior lender were canceled, the company said.
There was no outstanding debt to the second senior lender and the company said it did not anticipate needing to borrow further over the term of the $6 million revolving line of credit.
The senior lenders were not identified by Spacehab.
Spacehab develops, owns and operates modules that provide space-based laboratory research facilities.
